_help: Your own notes, shown in the tooltips. Save this file and they appear straight away.
registers: what each register holds in your program.
addresses: your own notes for memory addresses (written the way your assembler writes hex).
symbols:   notes for names that are not defined in your source.
files:     the same three sections again, for one source file only (these win over the general ones).
Anything starting with an underscore, like this _help, is ignored.
You can also write a note in the source itself with a comment line:   ; @reg R4 = player X
That kind of note applies from that line downwards, so different routines can use a register differently.
